name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments. [1]

flags.text: Profit compounded 105.2% vs revenue 53.9% over 5 years: margin expansion has done the work. Check it can last
Debtor days rose from 74 to 154 in three years: customers are taking longer to pay
Cash conversion cycle stretched from 162 to 193 days in three years
Capital work-in-progress is 32% of fixed assets: a big build-out is still to be commissioned
Share capital up 16% in three years: new shares from an issue, a merger or a bonus. Only the first two dilute
₹977 cr of profit over five years, yet operating cash flow was ₹-615 cr in total
Free cash flow negative in 5 of the last 5 years

business.what: Kaynes Technology is an electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company that builds products for OEM customers on contract. It is expanding into semiconductor OSAT, PCB manufacturing, smart metering (GridCrest), a US subsidiary (August Electronics) and space technology.

segments.name: EMS (electronics manufacturing services)
segments.comment: Grew about 40% overall, standalone much higher; the main growth driver this quarter.

segments.name: Smart metering (GridCrest)
segments.comment: Degrown per management; sales INR240 cr vs collections INR88 cr, production halted.

segments.name: OSAT (Kaynes Semicon)
segments.comment: Still ramping; trials nearly done, commercial billing expected from Q3 FY27.

segments.name: PCB (Kaynes Circuit)
segments.comment: Slightly delayed; commercial production expected next quarter, capacity requested by a global player.

segments.name: August Electronics (US subsidiary)
segments.comment: Acquired a year ago; good EBITDA margin business, growth expected to accelerate.

segments.name: Space technology (Crio Precision, Aerotech)
segments.comment: Titanium gas bottle orders from ISRO and DRDO; first 3U satellite in prototype stage.

kpis.name: GridCrest metering sales vs collections
kpis.value: Sales INR240 crore vs collections INR88 crore

ledger.promise: FY26 revenue to cross at least Rs 4,000 crore, led by EMS
ledger.quote: including the last quarter for FY '26, we'll cross about INR4,000 crores minimum and mainly driven by EMS revenues.
ledger.actual: FY26 revenue was Rs 3,626 crore, Rs 374 crore (9.4%) short. The Q4 FY26 call blamed West Asia deferrals and an EV customer cutting orders by about 90%.

ledger.promise: Consolidated operating cash flow positive by end of FY26
ledger.quote: going forward, at consol level, we'll definitely be OCF positive by end of this year.
ledger.actual: FY26 cash from operations was -Rs 600 crore, worse than -Rs 82 crore in FY25.

ledger.promise: Net working capital of about 85 days or better by March 2026, with visible improvement from normalisation measures
ledger.made_in: Q2 FY26 call (improvement); Q3 FY26 call (85 days)
ledger.quote: Working capital normalization measures are already underway and expected to show visible improvement going forward
ledger.actual: FY26 cash conversion cycle was 193 days, up from 102 in FY25. Debtor days went from 77 to 154 and inventory days from 156 to 169.

ledger.promise: H1 FY26 smart-meter revenue (about Rs 500 crore) collected in H2, and about Rs 240 crore of receivables discounted off the books before FY26 ends
ledger.quote: whatever revenue is booked in first half will get collected in the second half
ledger.actual: FY26 debtor days were 154, double FY25's 77. The Q4 FY26 call described a metering receivables build-up caused by government and installation delays.

ledger.promise: Reverse the metering receivables trend in Q1 FY27 and fix it within 3 quarters
ledger.quote: we will ensure that we reverse the trend in this quarter. And quarter after quarter, you will see, within 3 quarters of this year
ledger.actual: The Q1 FY27 call said receivables had not improved ('not a simple thing'). It moved the turnaround to end of year and the metering strategy to February.

ledger.promise: Smart-metering revenue of Rs 700-800 crore in FY26 (about Rs 500 crore H1 plus about Rs 300 crore H2)
ledger.made_in: Q2 FY26 call (split); Q3 FY26 call (range)
ledger.quote: Revenues will be of the order of about INR500-odd crores in the first half. And then, of course, in the second half, we also plan some execution, which will be of the nature of about INR300-odd crores
ledger.actual: The Q4 FY26 call reported FY26 metering sales of Rs 971 crore, above the range, but the cash was not collected (see receivables rows).

ledger.promise: Grow at twice the EMS market growth rate (market 16-18%, so about 32-36%) in FY27
ledger.quote: we are committing at doubling the growth of market growth, which we will be definitely coming back in every quarter
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 revenue was Rs 946 crore vs Rs 673 crore, up 40.6% year on year. That is one quarter only.

ledger.promise: Consolidated revenue of $1 billion (stated as INR 1,00,000 million, i.e. Rs 10,000 crore) in FY28
ledger.quote: At a consol level, we'll definitely deliver this number of $1 billion.
ledger.actual: TTM revenue is Rs 3,899 crore, so revenue needs to grow about 2.6x by FY28. The Q1 FY27 commitments listed here do not restate it.

ledger.promise: OSAT Unit 2 commercialised by 'Q2 '26', with OSAT revenue meaningful from FY27
ledger.made_in: Q2 FY26 call (FY27 revenue); Q4 FY26 call (Unit 2)
ledger.quote: the approval from these three customers will help us to do good revenues, starting from FY '27 onwards
ledger.actual: The Q1 FY27 call cited 'minor timing slippage': commercial production from Q2 FY27, operational by Q3 FY27, revenue booking in Q3-Q4 FY27. 'Q2 '26' is ambiguous.

ledger.promise: OSAT revenue of at least Rs 1,500 crore and PCB about Rs 1,000 crore (plans referenced to FY28)
ledger.quote: you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business. Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.
ledger.actual: Neither business has booked commercial revenue yet; revenue booking is guided for Q3-Q4 FY27.

ledger.promise: No further QIP or equity raise; capex fully funded (FY27 capex about Rs 300 crore OSAT, Rs 300 crore PCB, Rs 250 crore EMS)
ledger.quote: we are not going to come back for any QIP or something we are adequately funded.
ledger.actual: No equity raise is shown in these materials. Borrowings were Rs 913 crore in FY26 vs Rs 903 crore in FY25, while FY26 investing outflow was Rs 917 crore.

ledger.promise: Profitability to return to previously committed levels within a couple of quarters
ledger.quote: We expect this could take a couple of quarters for profitability to normalize and return to the levels as we had earlier committed to.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin was 15.6% vs 16.8% a year earlier. PAT was Rs 56 crore vs Rs 75 crore. Management guided to bottom-line pressure in Q2 FY27.

current_guidance.target: About twice EMS market growth (market 16-18%); no rupee number
current_guidance.quote: we are quite confident of achieving the twice the market growth

current_guidance.target: Commercial production starts Q2 FY27; Semicon Unit 2 and Chennai PCB operational by Q3 FY27
current_guidance.quote: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on the track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27
we are going to have a commercial revenue booking from this year, from third quarter and fourth quarter, and we are committed to that

current_guidance.target: Pressure on bottom line next quarter; margins back to earlier committed levels in a couple of quarters
current_guidance.horizon: Q2 FY27 to about Q4 FY27
current_guidance.quote: We expect this could take a couple of quarters for profitability to normalize and return to the levels as we had earlier committed to.

current_guidance.target: Turnaround in receivables; strategy update in February
current_guidance.quote: we are pretty confident that we will be able to do the turnaround by end of this year in terms of receivables from the metering business

current_guidance.target: About Rs 300 crore OSAT, Rs 300 crore PCB, Rs 250 crore EMS (about Rs 850 crore total)
current_guidance.quote: we will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business. We are on track for that.

credibility.label: low
credibility.summary: Management missed the main FY26 numbers it gave only months earlier: revenue came in at Rs 3,626 crore against at least Rs 4,000 crore, operating cash flow was -Rs 600 crore against a promise of positive, and the cash conversion cycle was 193 days against about 85. The metering receivables fix has been pushed back on every call since Q2 FY26, and OSAT/PCB timelines have slipped, so the one beat (metering revenue of Rs 971 crore against Rs 700-800 crore) came with cash that was not collected.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Higher inventory is deliberate and 'evens out in the last quarter'; net working capital of about 85 days by year end.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 cash conversion cycle was 193 days (FY25: 102), debtor days 154 (FY25: 77) and inventory days 169 (FY25: 156).

narrative_vs_numbers.story: The consolidated company will be operating-cash-flow positive by end of FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 cash from operations was -Rs 600 crore, against -Rs 82 crore in FY25, while investing outflow was Rs 917 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: The FY26 shortfall was caused by West Asia disruption and one EV customer cutting orders by about 90%: a timing problem, not a demand problem.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q4 FY26 revenue was Rs 1,243 crore, up 26% on Rs 984 crore, and FY26 revenue rose 33% to Rs 3,626 crore. Growth held up, but the company still missed its own Rs 4,000 crore target, set in February with only one quarter left.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Margin pressure in Q1 FY27 comes from cost escalation and from depreciation rising ahead of new-plant revenue.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 31% to Rs 148 crore (margin 15.6% vs 16.8%), but PBT fell to Rs 88 crore from Rs 96 crore and PAT to Rs 56 crore from Rs 75 crore. Most of the damage is below EBITDA, which fits the depreciation explanation.

bull.point: Revenue keeps growing quickly even after missing targets.
bull.evidence: Revenue went from Rs 1,805 crore (FY24) to Rs 3,626 crore (FY26). Q1 FY27 revenue was up 40.6% year on year, ahead of the twice-market (about 32-36%) guidance.

bull.point: Order book and new plants give visibility on revenue.
bull.evidence: Order book above Rs 9,000 crore. OSAT/PCB commercial production is guided from Q2 FY27, with revenue booking in Q3-Q4 FY27.
bull.source: Q4 FY26 call p12; Q1 FY27 call p8, p10

bull.point: Operating profit is growing and metering revenue beat guidance.
bull.evidence: FY26 EBITDA was Rs 578 crore vs Rs 416 crore (+39%). Metering sales were Rs 971 crore against Rs 700-800 crore guided.
bull.source: reported numbers; Q4 FY26 call p17

bear.point: Cash flow is getting worse and working capital has blown out.
bear.evidence: FY26 cash from operations was -Rs 600 crore and the cash conversion cycle was 193 days (102 in FY25), against promises of positive cash flow and about 85 days.
bear.source: reported numbers; Q3 FY26 call p7, p14

bear.point: Promises tend to be missed or moved back.
bear.evidence: FY26 revenue missed Rs 4,000 crore by Rs 374 crore. The metering receivables fix moved from H2 FY26 to Q1 FY27 to end of FY27. OSAT/PCB ramp-up slipped.
bear.source: Q2 FY26 call p17; Q4 FY26 call p12; Q1 FY27 call p4, p13

bear.point: Profit is falling while capex and depreciation rise, and the FY28 target looks stretched.
bear.evidence: TTM PAT is Rs 346 crore vs Rs 364 crore in FY26. Q1 FY27 PAT was Rs 56 crore vs Rs 75 crore, with more pressure guided. Hitting the $1 billion (Rs 10,000 crore) FY28 target needs about 2.6x TTM revenue of Rs 3,899 crore.
bear.source: reported numbers; Q1 FY27 call p15; Q3 FY26 call p17
